title: Push stamp (laptop, internal)
description: %USERPROFILE%\.agentspace\localswim-pushed.json (D9, D32, D40): the stamp of the last token push the box confirmed. Internal: written by up and sync after the box confirms a push, read by up to decide whether a push is due. A file that does not match this schema makes the next push due. It holds a hash that covers the token, never the token. Every other host's stamp has this same form in that host's folder (D50, D55): hosts\<project>\localswim-pushed.json on linux/arm64, and from v0.12 hosts\<project>.<os>-<arch>\localswim-pushed.json on any other platform (D91). The folder's name carries the platform, so a stamp is unchanged and holds no platform member (architect, 2026-11-26, for v0.12-T01, pin P14). Anchored patterns end with $(?!\n). See docs/state.md, "The push stamp", and docs/operator.md, "The stamp".

version.description: The format's version. 0 until a change that an older reader would misread.

stamp.description: The stamp, the SHA-256 that docs/operator.md "The stamp" defines, as 64 uppercase hex digits.
